おじいさん, これは なんですか？ 🥒 | Real-Life Japanese Conversation 🇯🇵 A little boy spends time with his grandfather in a peaceful Japanese countryside garden and discovers a fresh cucumber. 🥒🌿 He asks, 「おじいさん、これは なんですか？」 and learns how to talk about vegetables in simple, everyday Japanese. The conversation continues with useful beginner-friendly expressions like 「これは くだもの ですか？」, 「きゅうり を どう しますか？」, 「いちば で うります。」 and 「いま、いきましょう。」 Through this short grandfather-and-grandson story, you can learn simple and natural Japanese vocabulary and conversation used in daily life. 🇯🇵✨ 👍 If you enjoyed this lesson, don’t forget to Like, Comment, and Follow for more real-life Japanese conversations! #reels #LearnJapanese #JapaneseConversation #RealLifeJapanese #DailyJapanese
